Xi and Trump Discuss AI Risk Amid Tech War

Chinese President Xi Jinping and former US President Donald Trump met to discuss the risks associated with Artificial Intelligence (AI) amidst an escalating technology war between the two nations. The discussion also touched upon the ongoing trade war between the US and China.
